top_signals.title: Lula gana en Brasil; Bolsonaro pide anular el balotaje
top_signals.summary: Lula remontó y ganó la segunda vuelta presidencial de Brasil, asegurando un cuarto mandato sin precedentes. Pero la disputa electoral continúa: Bolsonaro pidió anular el balotaje tras una jornada electoral caótica. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Pick n Pay Bets on Springboks Rugby to Win Back Shoppers
top_signals.summary: Pick n Pay Stores Ltd. was a topic of conversation around South African barbecue grills for all the wrong reasons. Now, it’s betting on the national rugby team known as the Springboks to help change the conversation.

top_signals.title: Private equity pours billions into defense tech as investors debate a bubble
top_signals.summary: Private equity growth investments in defense reached $4 billion in the first nine months of 2026, up from $500 million in 2024.

top_signals.title: EU citizens think innovative foods can be useful but want more information, new Eurobarometer shows
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 26 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission published the results of a new Special Eurobarometer on food innovation, offering an EU-wide overview of how Europeans view innovative foods, ingredients and crops.
